description: Vessels whose name contains the text, case-insensitive, among every vessel the network has heard, each with its last known position. Use to turn a name into an MMSI, then get_vessels or find_vessels_near for detail. An optional bounding box narrows the search. With a feeder or partner token, text of the form IMO 9241061 finds the vessels reporting that IMO number, and a bare seven-digit number finds them ahead of the name matches.

bbox.description: only vessels whose last position is inside this box

flag.description: only vessels flying this flag: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. NO, FI, MH

name.description: text to find in the vessel name, at least 2 characters, case-insensitive; with a feeder or partner token, IMO followed by an IMO number finds that IMO

name: search_vessels_by_name

attribution.description: credit line per source kind in the rows, to show with the data

total.description: vessels matched before the limit was applied

truncated.description: true when rows were left out: total exceeds the rows returned, so narrow the query or raise limit, or an IMO number is reported by more than the 10 vessels returned for it

unknown_imo.description: requested IMO numbers matching no vessel the network has heard

unknown_mmsi.description: requested MMSIs matching no vessel the network has heard

bearing.description: degrees true from the search centre to the vessel (find_vessels_near)

destination.description: destination as typed by the crew: a port name, a UN/LOCODE, or nothing useful

distance_nm.description: nautical miles from the search centre (find_vessels_near)

draught.description: maximum static draught, metres; never for gear

eta.description: estimated arrival as sent, MM-DD HH:MM UTC or MM-DD; AIS carries no year, so read it as the next occurrence

flag.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the flag state, from the MMSI's maritime identification digits; never set for gear

heading.description: true heading, degrees, 0 to 359; never for gear

imo.description: IMO number, once the vessel's static data has been heard

kind.description: vessel, aton (aid to navigation), base (base station), sar (search and rescue aircraft or active distress beacon: AIS-SART, man-overboard, EPIRB-AIS), or gear (fishing gear, usually a net buoy, which has no flag)

lat.description: latitude of the last position, degrees; absent when no position has been heard

length.description: overall length, metres; never for gear, whose size is a placeholder

lon.description: longitude of the last position, degrees

name.description: name from the vessel's static data, when heard

particulars.description: particulars as registered, merged from the enrichment sources into one vocabulary (get_vessels)

callsign.description: call sign as registered; the callsign in the vessel's own properties is the one AIS reports

commons_category.description: the category of the ship's photos on Wikimedia Commons

draught.description: design draught, metres; AIS reports the draught on the current voyage

former_names.description: names the vessel has carried before, oldest first

identification.description: the flag state's number for the vessel: a documented vessel's official number, else its state registration

image.description: the Commons page of a photo of the ship, which shows its license and credit

length.description: length as registered, metres; may differ from the AIS length

registered_name.description: name as documented with the flag state, when it differs from what AIS reports

service.description: flag-state service type, e.g. Towing Vessel, Passenger (Inspected), Recreational

ship_type.description: kind of ship, e.g. bulk carrier, container ship, ferry

status.description: flag-state status, e.g. Active, Laid Up

tonnage_measure.description: how a tonnage from the flag state was measured: Convention (the international system), Regulatory (the older US system, in register tons), or Simplified (small vessels)

provenance.description: the source of each particulars field, by the field's name; values are keys of sources (get_vessels)

seen.description: time of the last message heard, RFC 3339 UTC

source.description: feed or station kind the last message came from

url.description: the source's page for this vessel, or its public search when the source keeps no per-vessel pages

sources.description: each contributing source's credit, license, and its own page for this vessel (get_vessels)

type.description: ITU ship and cargo type code, or the aid type for an aton

title: Search vessels by name
